authoredModes.semantic: signed quotient after division by 10, truncated toward zero

operation.provenBehavior: Reads the signed 16-bit global word at 0x0c22020c. Authored mode zero returns its signed remainder after division by ten; authored mode one returns its signed quotient truncated toward zero.

evidenceBoundary: Only the two exact authored mode forms receive semantics; the executable's unauthored mode two is not promoted.
The global word's owning gameplay subsystem remains unnamed.
Signed quotient and remainder behavior comes from the exact SH-4 division routines, not a decimal-display guess.
